craft_claim: Every dramatized scene must execute a measurable value change from positive to negative or vice versa through character action and obstacle collision.

supporting_evidence.note: McKee defines a scene as action through conflict in more or less continuous time and space that turns the value-charged condition of a character's life.

supporting_evidence.location: Genly Ai's audience with King Argaven
supporting_evidence.note: Scene begins with diplomatic hope and turns negatively into royal paranoia, exile of Estraven, and envoy vulnerability.

scope: Scenes in dramatic prose, screenplays, and stage scripts.
exceptions: Transitional establishing beats or purely descriptive atmospheric interludes.
